description: They are all mechatronic systems. Mechatronics is the engineering of smart machines, where mechanics, electronics, computing, and control come together in one design.

description: The word was coined in Japan in 1969, by Tetsuro Mori, an engineer at Yaskawa Electric. Mechanics, plus electronics.

description: Every mechatronic system follows one simple loop. Sensors measure the world. A controller, a small computer, decides what to do. Actuators, like motors, make it move. Then the sensors check the result, and the loop starts again.

provenance.prompt: Every mechatronic system follows one simple loop. Sensors measure the world. A controller, a small computer, decides what to do. Actuators, like motors, make it move. Then the sensors check the result, and the loop starts again.

description: Take a robot vacuum. Its sensors detect walls and dirt. Its chip plans a path. Its motors drive the wheels and brushes. Sense, think, act, many times every second.
